values.note: $20 a night at every rustic site, in 2026 (DNR rates table) and on the booking site for May, July and November dates through 2027. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Newaygo State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483543: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the Oak and Poplar maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13): every Oak and Poplar campsite on fee schedule -32479, $20 for 2026-11-17, 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13 + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Newaygo, Oak & Poplar Rustic: Rustic camping rate $20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/newaygo ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/newaygo ('There are no electricity, modern restrooms or showers.') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Newaygo State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483543: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the Oak and Poplar maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13) (all 99 campsites: 'Electrical Service=Not Available', 'Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 99 rustic campsites in two loops, Oak (#1-48) and Poplar (#49-99), with 20- to 30-ft forested buffers between them. Allowed rig lengths on the booking site run 25-50 ft; all but 3 take 30 ft or more. No pull-throughs listed.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/newaygo ('The Oak (sites #1-48) and Poplar (sites #49-99) campgrounds are noted for large, private sites and scenic beauty with 20- to 30-foot forested buffers between sites'; 'Number of sites: 99') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Newaygo State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483543: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the Oak and Poplar maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13) (Oak 48 and Poplar 51 campsites; per-site allowed equipment up to 25-50 ft), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water and trailer fill at the one-lane sanitation station near the campground office.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/newaygo ('There is access to drinking water and a place to fill trailers with potable water at the park's sanitation station. values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/newaygo (Newaygo Poplar and Oak Rustic Campgrounds: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Newaygo, Oak & Poplar Rustic: reservation season starts 'April 1', ends 'October 31') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (Newaygo State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483543: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the Oak and Poplar maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13) (99 bookable campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground in two loops (Oak #1-48, Poplar #49-99) atop 20-ft embankments overlooking Hardy Dam Pond, a 6-mile flooding of the Muskegon River; large private sites with 20- to 30-ft forested buffers. Boat launch between the loops with a few mooring spots for registered campers, buoyed swim area in the Poplar loop, kayak rentals at the office early June to mid-September, 18-hole disc golf; borders the Manistee National Forest. Spongy moth larvae can surge in summer. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + rates table: $20 for every rustic site in 2026 and 2027 (confirmed), no electric (confirmed), sewer false (new), 99 sites (confirmed) to 50 ft (new), vault toilets, potable water and dump (confirmed), no flush toilets or showers (new). Reservable on MiDNRReservations (confirmed); reservation season April 1 - October 31 into booking.season (new). Campground season left as derived 'seasonal' (no page states when it is open). Phone 231-856-4452 matches. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'not waterfront', but the DNR says the park 'sits atop 20-foot embankments overlooking the Hardy Dam Pond' and 'A buoyed swim area on Hardy Dam Pond is located in the Poplar Rustic Campground'.
